resources.string: Support the developer
Optional support that only unlocks White and Gold icons
Support DeskControl’s continued development
If DeskControl is useful to you, you can support its continued development with a one-time purchase. As a thank-you, you’ll be able to use the White and Gold alternate launcher icons.
Every feature works without a purchase
Touchpad, Motion Mouse, external-display control, and all other features stay exactly the same. You can keep using every feature and the Default icon without buying anything.
